entities.summary: Tony Costner is an American former professional basketball player, who was selected by the Washington Bullets, in the second round of the 1984 NBA draft. He played professionally in Europe and in the Continental Basketball Association (CBA). Costner was a 6-foot-10-inch (2.08 m) tall center, that played in college at Saint Joseph's University. He is the father of former professional basketball player Brandon Costner.
